From b062938fd9afec844c50571fddd8d81623a60ee1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>
Date: Mon, 27 May 2024 14:19:40 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: Intel: sof-sdw: fix missing SPI_MASTER dependency

The addition of the Cirrus Logic 'sidecar' amps adds a dependency on SPI_MASTER.

Kconfig warnings: (for reference only)
   WARNING: unmet direct dependencies detected for SND_SOC_CS35L56_SPI
   Depends on [n]:
     SOUND [=y] && SND [=y] && SND_SOC [=y] && SPI_MASTER [=n] &&
     (SOUNDWIRE [=y] || !SOUNDWIRE [=y])
   Selected by [y]:
    - SND_SOC_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE_SOF_MACH [=y] && SOUND [=y] && SND [=y]
      && SND_SOC [=y] && SND_SOC_INTEL_MACH [=y] &&
      SND_SOC_SOF_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE [=y] && I2C [=y] && ACPI [=y] &&
      (MFD_INTEL_LPSS [=y] || COMPILE_TEST [=n]) &&
      (SND_SOC_INTEL_USER_FRIENDLY_LONG_NAMES [=y] || COMPILE_TEST
      [=n]) && SOUNDWIRE [=y]

Fixes: b831b4dca48d ("ASoC: intel: sof_sdw: Add support for cs42l43-cs35l56 sidecar amps")
Reported-by: kernel test robot <lkp@intel.com>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/oe-kbuild-all/202405140758.o2HY4nYD-lkp@intel.com/
Signed-off-by: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Bard Liao <yung-chuan.liao@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://msgid.link/r/20240527191940.30107-1-pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com
Reviewed-by: Charles Keepax <ckeepax@opensource.cirrus.com>
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig b/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
index 3ed81ab649c5..4e0586034de4 100644
--- a/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
+++ b/sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig
@@ -652,7 +652,7 @@ if SND_SOC_SOF_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE
 
 config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE_SOF_MACH
 	tristate "SoundWire generic machine driver"
-	depends on I2C && ACPI
+	depends on I2C && SPI_MASTER && ACPI
 	depends on MFD_INTEL_LPSS || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on SND_SOC_INTEL_USER_FRIENDLY_LONG_NAMES || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on SOUNDWIRE
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `sound/soc/intel/boards/Kconfig`**
   - The dependency for the configuration option `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE_SOF_MACH` was modified. 
   - The line:
     ```plaintext
     depends on I2C && ACPI
     ```
     was changed to:
     ```plaintext
     depends on I2C && SPI_MASTER && ACPI
     ```
   - This change adds a new dependency on `SPI_MASTER`, indicating that the SoundWire generic machine driver now requires SPI support.

### Relationships

- The modification in the `Kconfig` file addresses a previously reported issue regarding unmet dependencies for the `SND_SOC_CS35L56_SPI` configuration. The addition of the `SPI_MASTER` dependency ensures that the necessary support for SPI is available when the SoundWire machine driver is selected, thus resolving the warnings related to unmet dependencies.
- This patch is a direct response to the issues raised by the kernel test robot and is linked to a previous commit that introduced support for Cirrus Logic sidecar amplifiers, which necessitated the SPI dependency.

ASoC: Intel: sof-sdw: fix missing SPI_MASTER dependency

      (SND_SOC_INTEL_USER_FRIENDLY_LONG_NAMES [=y] || COMPILE_TEST

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the absence of the `SPI_MASTER` dependency in the `Kconfig` configuration for the `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE_SOF_MACH`, which is required for the proper functioning of the SoundWire generic machine driver and the associated Cirrus Logic sidecar amplifiers. This led to unmet dependencies for the `SND_SOC_CS35L56_SPI` configuration, resulting in warnings during the build process.

Here is the patch:
 config SND_SOC_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE_SOF_MACH
 	tristate "SoundWire generic machine driver"
-	depends on I2C && ACPI
+	depends on I2C && SPI_MASTER && ACPI
 	depends on MFD_INTEL_LPSS || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on SND_SOC_INTEL_USER_FRIENDLY_LONG_NAMES || COMPILE_TEST

Reason:
The absence of the `SPI_MASTER` dependency in the `Kconfig` configuration for `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE_SOF_MACH` means that the necessary support for SPI communication is not included, which is required for the proper functioning of the SoundWire generic machine driver and the associated Cirrus Logic sidecar amplifiers. This results in unmet dependencies for the `SND_SOC_CS35L56_SPI` configuration, causing warnings during the build process.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
depends on I2C && SPI_MASTER && ACPI
```
Reason:
By adding the `SPI_MASTER` dependency to the `Kconfig` configuration for `SND_SOC_INTEL_SOUNDWIRE_SOF_MACH`, the necessary support for SPI communication is now included, ensuring that the SoundWire generic machine driver and the Cirrus Logic sidecar amplifiers can function correctly without unmet dependencies, thus resolving the build warnings.
